tagline: A daily sunscreen designed to provide high UV protection while supporting the skin barrier and keeping skin comfortable.
description: Designed for everyday use, DAILY SHIELD SUNSCREEN provides broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection with SPF 50 PA++++. Its sweat-resistant cream-gel formula is designed for comfortable daily wear, with a non-greasy finish.
image_alt: EMBRAE Daily Shield Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++, 50 g cream-gel sunscreen
benefits: Broad spectrum UVA and UVB protection
routine_heading: Protect is where the day begins
routine_text: Add Reset, Defend and Adapt to complete the routine.
essentials_heading: Daily Shield Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++, at a glance.

howto.title: Apply
howto.text: Dispense an adequate amount and apply generously and evenly to face and neck 15 minutes before sun exposure.

howto.title: Reapply
howto.text: Reapply every 2 hours if exposed to sun.

inci: Purified Water, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Octyl Methoxycinnamate, Glycerin, Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Extract, C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate, Propylene Glycol, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Niacinamide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Acrylates Copolymer, Triethanolamine, Ethyl Ascorbic Acid, Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol, Ceramide EOP, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Disodium EDTA, Allantoin, Alpha-Arbutin, Ectoin.
storage:
Storage instructions
Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place. Protect from direct sunlight and excessive heat. Keep the cap closed when not in use.

Caution
Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with water.

Note
Perform a patch test before use. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

For external use only.
